newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks seen up on speculative buying.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks seen up on speculative buying.

text.p: Pakistan stocks are set to soar on Thursday on speculative new accounts day buying of select blue chips, but dealers said the broader market was weak.

"The index will go up on new accounts day buying of index-weighted stocks," dealer Rony Byramjee said. "But losers will beat gainers as genuine investors and local institutions are likely to remain on the sidelines."
Dealers said long-term investors remained deterred by Pakistan's gloomy economic outlook.
On Wednesday, the Karachi 100-share index rose 25.29 points, or 1.59 percent, to 1,618.15. Losers led gainers 173 to 110.
Turnover fell to 45.69 million shares from 53.34 million in the previous session.
